info.title: Domolov API
info.description: REST API of Domolov, a self-hosted real-estate listing hunter. Sign in with POST /api/session; the session cookie authenticates later calls. State-changing requests must send the header `X-Requested-With: domolov`. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

get.summary: Get the current session (401 when signed out)

post.summary: Sign in with the operator password; sets the session cookie

delete.summary: Revoke every session, including this one

get.summary: List Watches with their routes, last scan and next run

post.summary: Create a Watch (optionally with its first notification route); the first scan is queued

get.summary: Get a Watch (ETag for conditional updates)

patch.summary: Rename, reschedule, change the search URL, or pause/resume a Watch

delete.summary: Delete a Watch with its routes, scans and sightings

post.summary: Queue a scan now (Run now); returns the active ScanRun
Check whether a pasted search URL is supported and suggest a Watch name

get.summary: Headline numbers, Unseen Homes, price drops, Watch health and active scans
Read-only server configuration and capability flags

patch.summary: Change a route's destination, triggers or enabled flag

post.summary: Send a sample notification through the route right now

get.summary: The Homes feed: one card per Home with filters, sorting and paging
A Home with every ad in its history, price history and possible matches

put.summary: Bookmark a Home or change its stage and note
Dismiss a Home: hidden from feeds and never notified (removes its Bookmark)

post.summary: Mark every Unseen Home as seen
Link another ad to this Home (same home)

delete.summary: Split an ad off this Home (not the same home); returns the new Home

patch.summary: Confirm (same home) or reject (different homes) a possible match

get.summary: One ad with its price history

delete.summary: Delete every Listing and Home (danger zone)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events: 'scanRun' on every ScanRun change, 'ping' every 25 s
Diagnostics captured during a ScanRun (Cloudflare screenshots, HTML, headers)
Database size, largest tables and cleanup status

post.summary: Ask the worker to run the retention cleanup now
Store this browser's Web Push subscription

BookmarkBoardResponse.description: The Bookmark board: Homes grouped by stage.

BookmarkResponse.description: A Bookmark as returned by the API.

BookmarkStage.description: Where the operator is with a Bookmarked Home. Ordered from least to most advanced.

CountResponse.description: Number of Homes affected by a bulk operation.

CreateWatchRequest.description: Payload for creating a Watch, optionally with its first notification route.

DomolovRole.description: Which parts of Domolov this process runs.

HomeListingResponse.description: One ad in the Home's history.

HomeListingRole.description: Role of a Listing within its Home's history.

HomeMatchResponse.description: A HomeMatch with both sides for side-by-side review.

HomeSummaryResponse.description: A Home card: the Home plus key facts of its Primary Listing.

LinkListingRequest.description: Manually link an ad to a Home.

ListingDetailResponse.description: One ad with its price history and the Watches that sighted it.

MarkAllSeenRequest.description: Mark Homes seen up to a point in time (defaults to now).

MatchListingResponse.description: The ad side of a HomeMatch.

MatchSettingsResponse.description: Matching settings shown in the UI.

MatchSignalsResponse.description: Why two ads look like the same Home.

NotificationRouteResponse.description: A NotificationRoute as returned by the API.

NotificationTrigger.description: Flags describing when a NotificationRoute should fire.

PagedResponseOfHomeSummaryResponse.description: A page of results with the total count.

PagedResponseOfScanRunResponse.description: A page of results with the total count.

PricePointResponse.description: A price point of one of the Home's Listings.

PushSubscriptionResponse.description: The stored subscription id (used to unsubscribe).

RetentionSettingsResponse.description: Retention settings shown in the UI.

ReviewMatchRequest.description: Confirm or reject a Possible match.

ScanArtifactKind.description: Kind of diagnostic captured during a ScanRun.

ScanRunResponse.description: A ScanRun as returned by the API and pushed over SSE.

SearchUrlCheckRequest.description: Asks whether a pasted search URL is supported.

SearchUrlCheckResponse.description: Result of a search URL check, with a suggested Watch name.

SessionListItem.description: A session in the session list.

SettingsResponse.description: Read-only server configuration and capability flags.

TableStorage.description: Size and approximate row count of one table.

TestDeliveryResponse.description: Outcome of sending a test notification.

UpdateWatchRequest.description: Partial update of a Watch; omitted fields stay unchanged.

WatchRefResponse.description: A Watch that sighted a Listing.

WatchResponse.description: A Watch as returned by the API.
